title: Hollow Charred Spanish Chicken Catalan Ensaimada
description: Tender, charred Spanish chicken, wrapped in a classic Catalan Ensaïmada pastry, paired with a flavorful basmati rice dish. Perfect for a date-night dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken breasts and mix until coated.
Stuff the Ensaïmada pastry with the marinated chicken breasts and fold the pastry to seal.
Place the stuffed pastry on a rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving space between each pastry.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, prepare the basmati rice according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, lemon zest, and chopped parsley. Set aside.
Once the pastry is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Slice the pastry in half lengthwise and hollow out the center, leaving about 1 inch of the pastry intact.
Stuff the hollowed-out pastry with the cooked basmati rice and drizzle with the lemon-parsley mixture.
Serve immediately and garnish with additional parsley if desired.
